preview: Hello. I'll be here with you, guiding your attention gently through the body.
intro_1: Welcome. Find a comfortable position, lying down or sitting, and let your eyes close, if that feels right.
intro_2: Take a slow breath in... and let it go.
intro_3: In this practice, we'll move our attention slowly through the body. There's nothing you need to do, or change.
intro_4: You can pause, or stop, at any time.
intro_short: Welcome. Settle in, and take one slow breath. You can pause, or stop, at any time.
intro_cues: Settle into a comfortable position. I'll name each area of the body, and then leave you in quiet. You can pause, or stop, at any time.
outro_1: Now, let your attention widen, to include the whole body, from head to toe.
outro_2: Rest here for a moment, simply breathing.
outro_3: When you're ready, gently move your fingers and toes... and slowly open your eyes.
outro_4: Your practice is complete. Thank you for taking this time for yourself.
outro_short: Let your awareness rest on the whole body. Your practice is complete.
guide_head: Bring your attention to the top of your head. Notice the scalp, and any sensations resting there.
guide_face: Let your attention move to your face. Your forehead... your eyes... your cheeks. Let them soften.
guide_jaw: Now notice your jaw and mouth. If there is any tightness, see if it can loosen, just a little.
guide_neck: Bring your awareness to your neck and throat. Notice the breath, moving gently through this space.
guide_chest: Let your attention rest on your chest. Feel it rise... and fall, with each breath.
guide_upperBack: Now bring your awareness to your upper back. Notice the places where it meets the surface beneath you.
guide_abdomen: Let your attention move to your belly. Notice it softening, and expanding, as you breathe.
guide_lowerBack: Now notice your lower back. If there is any holding here, let the breath meet it, with kindness.
guide_hips: Bring your awareness to your hips and pelvis. Notice the weight of the body, resting here.
prompt_1: Notice whatever is here. Warmth, or coolness... tingling... or perhaps nothing at all.
prompt_2: There's nothing to change. Simply notice.
prompt_3: If your mind has wandered, that's okay. Gently guide it back.
prompt_4: With each out-breath, let this area soften, a little more.
prompt_5: Stay with these sensations, with curiosity, and kindness.
prompt_7: If there's discomfort, notice it gently, without needing to push it away.
